## Right Page: Baptismal Register (1836)

> **2**
> Register for 1836
> * **Augt. 14th** I Baptized Catherine Legitimate daughter of Daniel Biggan and Margaret Cummins Sponsors were James Hourigan & Mary O'Dea.
> * **Item** I Baptized Catherine Legitimate Daughter of Patrick Shanahan & Bridget Gleeson Sponsors were James Lynch & Mary Gleeson
> * **Sept. 4th** I Baptized Joseph Legitimate Son of John Benson & Margaret Kenny Sponsors were John Sheehy & Margt. Lynch
> * **Sept. 5th** I Baptized Michl Legitimate Son of John Nunan & Catherine Madden Sponsors were Thos. Guerin & Bridt. Guerin
> * **Sept. 17th** I Baptized Margret Legitimate daugr of Michl. Brown & Mary Hayes Sponsors were Denis Sheehy and Helen Brown
> * **Sept. 17th** I Baptized Catherine Legitimate Daughter of John Eason and Helen Doyle Sponsors were John Satchfield and Mary Madden
> 
> 
> **Patrick S. J. Benson V.P.**
> **Croagh**

---

### Notes on the Text:

* **"Do" / "Ditto"**: Used extensively on the left page to indicate that the surname "Ruttle" and the date "Oct. 29" apply to the subsequent rows.
* **"Item"**: A Latin term commonly used in older registers meaning "likewise" or "similarly," used here to denote the next entry in the sequence without repeating the specific date.
* **"Croagh"**: Found at the very bottom right, indicating the parish location (Croagh, County Limerick, Ireland).Here is the transcription of the 1836 parish baptism register pages shown in **image_7645a5.png**.

The text contains standard abbreviations of the era (e.g., *Michl.* for Michael, *Bridgt.* for Bridget, *Spons.* for Sponsors, *Daur.* for Daughter). Missing or faded text is indicated in brackets.

**1836**

**Sepr. 18th**
I Baptized Ellen Legitimate Daur. of John Hayes and Mary Condon. Sponsors were Paul Hayes & Mary Scanlan.

**Idem [same day]**
I Baptized Mary Legitimate Daur. of Michl. Hayes & Mary Condon. Sponsors were Edmd. Hayes & Ann Condon.

**Idem**
I Baptized Mary Legitimate Daur. of Michl. Meany & Ellen Fitzgerald. Sponsors were John Maddagan & Bridgt. Meany.

**Sepr. 25th**
I Baptized John son of Richard Guonane & Ellen Carrol. Sponsors were Michl. Purtil & Johana Henesy.

**Sepr. 28th**
I Baptized James son of Edmond & Daniel [?] & Catherine Walker. Sponsors were Michl. Walker & Bridgt. Stokes.

**Idem**
I Baptized Elizabeth Daughter of Michl. White & Elizabeth Nunan. Sponsors were Michl. White & Mary White.

**Oct. 9th**
I Baptized Mary Legitimate Daughter of Michl. Hogan & [Eliza Bourke. Sponsors were Maurice Hogan & Ann Thompson]*

The register is split into two pages, with entries primarily following a standard formula: *"I Baptized [Name] Legitimate [son/daughter] of [Father] & [Mother]. Sponsors were [Sponsor 1] and [Sponsor 2]"*. Standard abbreviations of the era (e.g., *Margt.* for Margaret, *Michl.* or *Michl:* for Michael, *Thos.* for Thomas) and archaic spellings (like *Legitimate* sometimes written as *Legitimate* or *Legitimate do.* for daughter) have been transcribed as they appear.
